candidates.change_summary: Change return value from selector to 0x0 (bytes4(0)).
Replace the assignment of baseToken to a constant zero address so that the state variable is always set to address(0).
Change the assignment of baseToken to a different input parameter (nft) so that baseToken takes the nft address instead.
Set nft to address(0) instead of _nft.
Set nft to msg.sender instead of _nft.
Delete the assignment to nft, leaving it at its default value (address(0)).
Swap the assignments of baseToken and nft.
Replace assignment of changeFee with a different constant value
Replace changeFee assignment with assignment from a different parameter
Change the upper bound check on _feeRate from 5_000 to a lower value (e.g., 500) so that valid fees above 500 bps are rejected, altering the stored feeRate.
Change the assignment of feeRate to always store 0, instead of the passed _feeRate.
Remove the assignment of `initialized = true;` to a no-op by setting `initialized` to `false`.
Remove the line `initialized = true;` so that the variable is never set to true.
Move the `initialized = true;` assignment before the `if (initialized)` check so that reentrant calls will not revert on the second call if the first call completes normally.
Change the assignment of payRoyalties from _payRoyalties to !_payRoyalties
Change the assignment to useStolenNftOracle from _useStolenNftOracle to the opposite boolean value.
Replace the assignment to virtualBaseTokenReserves with a different value (e.g., zero) so that after initialize the state variable differs.
